mapper.select: /* LeaveDeductionMapper.selectDailySchedule */ SELECT S.SCH_CD AS schCd , S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstSchStrTime , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstSchEndTime , S.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN AS fstSchBrkMin , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secSchStrTime , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secSchEndTime , S.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN AS secSchBrkMin , S.FST_BRK_STR_TIME AS fstBrkStrTime , S.FST_BRK_END_TIME AS fstBrkEndTime , S.SEC_BRK_STR_TIME AS secBrkStrTime , S.SEC_BRK_END_TIME AS secBrkEndTime FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT S ON S.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND S.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE WP.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND WP.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} LIMIT 1
